title: Free Flight
features:
🆓 Features (100% Free Script)
1. ✈️ Auto Flight Tool Copier
Workspace Scanner: Automatically scans the game's workspace for FlightHandler or Flight tools.

Auto-Cloner: Clones the tools directly into your Backpack (Inventory) so you can fly immediately.

2. 🎨 Custom Animated GUI
Smooth Popup: Displays a sleek notification window with smooth Back easing entrance animations.

Modern Design: Features custom purple-to-blue gradient backgrounds, glowing neon blue borders, and rounded corners.

Floating Avatar Logo: Displays a circular image header that floats up and down continuously.

Gradient Text: Displays stylized text: "You Got A Flight Tool By Li_Family Developer".

3. 🔊 Sound Effect
Plays a custom sound effect (rbxassetid://452267918) as soon as the script executes.

4. ⏱️ Auto-Cleanup
The UI stays on screen for 6 seconds, then smoothly shrinks down and completely deletes itself to keep your screen clean.
